en.title: The Poison That Came Before the Nectar | Samudra Manthan
en.description:
Even the gods can lose all their power. This is how they got it back.

The churning of the ocean: a mountain, a serpent, a poison, and the nectar of immortality.

Retold from the Bhagavata Purana, Canto 8, chapters 5-9.

Subscribe for a new Purana story every day.
